# Hologram brand assets

Vendored from https://github.com/Hologram-Technologies/hologram-brand-kit at
`f14a9d8cfe6bce14fc8a6ff09ac0f99b01e300be` (`develop`). Every Prism browser closure (closure v2) carries these
files: the Geist, Geist Mono and Archivo web fonts under the SIL Open Font
License 1.1 (the licence texts ship beside them), and an app icon composed
from the kit's white logomark on the warm dark ground `#151312`.

Regenerate only from a pinned kit commit, then update MANIFEST.sha256 and
the `hologram-brand` row of `model/dependencies.toml`.
